summary: The cmd shell plugin is the Windows Command Prompt, used with winrm or with ssh when no DefaultShell is set on the Windows host.
questions: When does Ansible use cmd.exe on Windows?
Which shell plugin is used for Windows over SSH by default?

answer_card.title: Windows cmd shell plugin
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.cmd` (shell plugin) is the Windows Command Prompt, used with `winrm` or with `ssh` when the Windows host has no `DefaultShell` set.
